title: Expected behavior violation in AMD Secure Encrypted Virtualization (SEV) firmware could allow a malicious hypervisor…
description: A vulnerability in AMD Secure Encrypted Virtualization (SEV) firmware allows a malicious hypervisor to bypass Reverse Map Table (RMP) protections. This could lead to a loss of memory integrity for SEV-SNP guests. The issue is classified as a medium severity vulnerability with a CVSS score of 5.9. No affected versions or patch information are provided.
